title: ProducerOutline
description: Agent A's (A3 Story Architecture) structural plan for the episode. Downstream of fact_pack.json: every supporting_claim_ids/unresolved_claim_ids entry must reference a claim_id that exists there, and this file must not introduce factual claims fact_pack.json doesn't contain. visual_requests are requests to Agent B, not evidence that any asset exists.

thesis.description: The one-sentence argument/story the episode is built around. Must be supported by fact_pack.json claims, not auto-derived from episode_brief.quirk.

thesis_claim_ids.description: fact_pack.json claim_ids backing every factual assertion in the thesis. All must be allowed_in_narration: true -- an unresolved claim must never reach the thesis.

hook.description: The cold-open line(s) meant to grab attention before the thesis unfolds

hook_claim_ids.description: fact_pack.json claim_ids backing every factual assertion in the hook. All must be allowed_in_narration: true -- an unresolved claim must never reach the hook.

estimated_runtime_sec.description: Set by Agent A during A3, after fact_pack.json and the beat structure exist -- never hardcoded. Should sit near the channel's runtime_policy.preferred_minutes (config/channels/<channel_id>.json) as a center of gravity, not a fixed target; actual length follows evidence density, story density, and expected visual density. Never pad to a target.

runtime_rationale.description: Why this runtime, in terms of evidence density / story density / visual density -- not required, but keeps the estimate auditable instead of a bare number

open_questions.description: Outline-level open questions that aren't tied to one fact_pack claim (e.g. structural/strategic questions). Per-claim uncertainty belongs in fact_pack.json instead.

beats.description: Ordered narrative beats making up the episode

act.description: Optional. Which act (1-4) this beat belongs to, for channels whose config defines an act_structure (see config/channels/<channel_id>.json). Acts are fixed and ordered; beats within an act are flexible. Omit entirely for channels/episodes not using an act structure.

estimated_narration_sec.description: Optional. This beat's share of estimated_runtime_sec, for act-structured channels balancing narration time across acts. Not required when act is omitted.

purpose.description: Why this beat exists -- its narrative function in the episode

supporting_claim_ids.description: fact_pack.json claim_ids (allowed_in_narration: true) this beat is built on

unresolved_claim_ids.description: fact_pack.json claim_ids this beat references but that are NOT allowed_in_narration -- must be framed as open/unconfirmed if mentioned at all, never stated as fact

narration_direction.description: Guidance for the A4 localized-writing stage -- talking points and tone, NOT final narration text

visual_requests.description: Structured requests to Agent B. A request, not evidence the asset exists.

exact_subject_required.description: If true, only footage/imagery of the exact subject satisfies this request -- generic/contextual substitutes are not acceptable. If false, contextual/period-appropriate substitutes are acceptable.
